name: BadInstruction_Handler
comment: Purpose: A trap or handler for when the CPU encounters an unknown/bad instruction. This is likely a default interrupt vector.

name: util_integer_to_string
comment: Purpose: Converts an unsigned integer into a null-terminated ASCII string. This is a common 'itoa' implementation. param_1: Pointer to a buffer/struct. The resulting string is stored at offset +0x24 from this pointer. param_3: The unsigned integer to convert.

name: lib_memset
comment: Purpose: Standard library function to fill a block of memory with a specific byte value. It's optimized for word/half-word writes. param_1: (void*) destination pointer. param_2: (uint) number of bytes to fill. param_3: (byte) value to fill with.

name: lib_bzero
comment: Purpose: Standard library function to fill a block of memory with zeros. It's an optimized 'memset(..., 0, ...)' or 'bzero'. param_1: (void*) destination pointer. param_2: (uint) number of bytes to write.

name: lib_strncpy
comment: Purpose: Standard library function to copy a string with a maximum length, padding with nulls if src is shorter than len. param_1: (char*) destination. param_2: (char*) source. param_3: (int) max length. Calls lib_bzero (FUN_80000f94) to pad.

name: Display_Buffer_Flush
comment: Streams the prepared frame buffer to the LCD over the external bus while holding PC12 as chip select. Asserts GPIOC12, primes DMA (DAT_8000396c), waits for completion, then releases the line.

name: SI4732_Write_Command
comment: Purpose: Sends a 6-byte command packet over a serial bus (likely I2C or SPI) and then delays. param_1: (uint16_t) A 16-bit value split into two bytes in the packet. Notes: Calls FUN_8000b7a6 (a delay function) for 50ms (0x32).

name: BK4829_Init
comment: Purpose: Initializes a complex external peripheral (like a radio or codec) by writing a long sequence of register/value pairs. Notes: Calls a function pointer at DAT_80008180+8, likely a 'write_reg(offset, value)' function.

name: Flash_Read_Write_Block
comment: Purpose: Reads or writes a 128-byte (0x80) block from/to specific addresses in the main Flash or an external SPI Flash. param_1: (int) 0 = Read, 1 = Write. Notes: Accesses addresses like 0x8000, 0x9000, 0xb000, 0xf000.

name: Bluetooth_UART1_Init
comment: Configures USART1 (PA9/PA10 at 115200 baud) and routes it to the external Bluetooth module via GPIOA remap. Enables pins with FUN_8001272c (0x400 mask) loads 0x1C200 into USART1 (0x40013800) and sets TE/RE bits before enabling the peripheral.

name: Bluetooth_CommandSequencer
comment: Builds and sends command frames to the Bluetooth module including triggering SPI flash erases and UART transactions. Drives USART callbacks captured in FUN_8000834c/FUN_800226b0; orchestrates Software_SPI_FlashErase* routines when reprogramming BT firmware.

name: Util_Calculate_XOR_Checksum
comment: Purpose: Calculates a simple 8-bit XOR checksum over a block of data. param_1: (uint) length. param_2: (byte*) data buffer.

name: RF_Apply_Frequency_Offset
comment: Purpose: Applies a frequency offset to a base frequency. Used for RF channel selection. Notes: Selects a channel struct based on index at DAT_80008930+0xf4. Reads base freq from offset +0x108, offset from +0x134, and writes result to +0x114.

name: Channel_Load_Config
comment: Purpose: Loads and parses configuration data for a specific channel (0, 1, or 2) from Flash into its runtime struct. param_1: (int) channel index [0-2]. param_2: (int) 1 = read from flash. param_3: (int) flash offset. Notes: Populates the struct at DAT_80009428 + (param_1 * 0x58).

name: BK4829_ReadBlock_WithCRC
comment: Purpose: Reads a block of data from an SPI peripheral and calculates a CRC-16 checksum on the fly. param_1: (uint) number of bytes to read. Notes: Uses CRC-16-CCITT-FALSE (poly 0x1021). `FUN_8002112c` is the byte read function.

name: GPS_Parse_NMEA_Coordinate
comment: Purpose: Parses an NMEA coordinate string (like $GPRMC) into a data structure. param_1: (char*) NMEA string. param_2: (struct*) struct to fill. Notes: Identifies N/S (0x4E/0x53) and E/W (0x45/0x57) and converts DDMM.MMMM format.

name: Modem_Scramble_Whiten_Data
comment: Purpose: Scrambles/whitens a 7-byte block of data, likely for GMSK/FSK modulation. param_1: (byte*) input buffer. param_2: (byte*) output buffer. Notes: Uses a complex bit-shifting and XOR feedback algorithm.

name: DAC_Channel_Enable
comment: Sets or clears enable bits in the DAC control register at 0x40007400. param_1: bit index (channel/trigger); param_2: 1 enable 0 disable.

name: DAC_BufferGate
comment: Controls the DAC buffer/trigger configuration bits prior to playback. param_1: bit index (buffer flag); param_2: 1 set 0 clear.

name: DAC_WaveformWrite
comment: Loads a combined waveform/control word into the DAC waveform register block. param_1: shift amount; param_2: pointer to packed control words.

name: BK4829_SetCDCSSCodeWord
comment: Sets up DCS (CDCSS) on the BK4829, not the frequency: REG_51 = CDCSS enable/threshold, REG_07 = 0x0AD7 (CTC1 mode, 2775), then REG_08 twice with the low and high 12 bits of the 23-bit Golay code word. Same sequence as BK4819_SetCDCSSCodeWord in the UV-K5 firmware. param_1: DCS code, param_2: 3 selects 0x8000 instead of 0xA000 in REG_51, param_3: 0 = compute the code word.

name: Delay
comment: Purpose: A blocking delay function, likely in milliseconds. param_1: (uint) Number of milliseconds to delay. Notes: Calls a nested spin-wait loop (FUN_8000b7c2).

name: ToneMenu_SetLabel
comment: Writes the text label for a tone slot on the LCD tone selection screen. param_1: column/slot index; param_2: tone class (RX/TX/etc.); param_3: UI variant. Selects appropriate string and positions it.

name: ToneMenu_ShowEntry
comment: Formats and renders the currently selected CTCSS/DCS tone or 'OFF' entry on the LCD. param_1: column slot (RX/TX/etc.); param_2: tone index (0xFFFF => OFF); param_3: tone category. Calls ToneGraphic_Draw to highlight the active selection.

name: ToneMenu_DrawFrequency
comment: Formats and draws frequency/offset text under the tone selection entry. param_1: row; param_2: column; param_3: tone frequency in Hz*10; param_4: colour/palette.

name: ToneGraphic_Draw
comment: Draws the tone bargraph/selection cursor and incorporates the tone palette for the current menu context. param_1: context (0=receive 1=transmit 2=dual); param_2: number of highlighted cells; param_3: palette id; param_4: non-zero to flush LCD.

name: AudioDMA_Trigger
comment: Arms DMA2 with a new sample buffer targeting DAC1 for tone or AFSK playback. Writes length and buffer pointer into DMA2 registers (base 0x40020430) before re-enabling the channel.

name: Encoder_Handle_Quadrature
comment: State machine for the front-panel rotary encoder on PB4/PB5; debounces movement and queues UI actions. Reads FUN_80012c26(DAT_8000e428,0x10/0x20) and calls FUN_8000e42c() to clear the latch.

name: APRS_SetPTT
comment: Maps APRS modem PTT state onto the GPIO/expander lines (command 0x4001). param_1: 0=release PTT 1=assert.

name: APRS_SendCommand11
comment: Sends modem command 0x11 (initialise/reset) and waits 600 ms for completion. Used when switching modem operating modes or recovering from errors.

name: APRS_Modem_CheckReady
comment: Issues modem command 0x14 and inspects the returned status byte for busy/ready. Returns 2 when the modem signals ready-to-send and triggers APRS_Modem_ReadStatus.

name: APRS_Modem_ReadStatus
comment: Fetches status payload from the external APRS/AFSK modem via command 0x42/0x22 and caches it. Updates status buffer stores RSSI/flags and toggles modem lines with APRS_SetPTT.

name: APRS_Modem_StartTX
comment: Primes the modem for transmit enabling PTT and writing control bytes before sending audio. Calls APRS_SetPTT(1) queues command frames via FUN_80026fb2 and mirrors status into shared buffers.

name: Keypad_ScanMatrix
comment: Periodically drives PC0-PC3 high and samples PD4-PD7 to decode the 5x4 keypad; gated by PE5 and PA12. Uses DAT_800136d8 (GPIOC) for columns, DAT_800136dc (GPIOD) for rows, DAT_800136d0 (PE5) and DAT_800136d4 (PA12) to enable scanning.

name: ADC_Read_PA1
comment: Single conversion on ADC2 channel 1 (PA1) returning an 8-bit scaled value used for audio level logic. Calls FUN_80003108(DAT_80013cd0,1,1,7) then waits on FUN_800030a4 before reading FUN_8000309e.

name: ADC_Read_PA0
comment: Single conversion on ADC2 channel 0 (PA0) for battery/AGC sensing. Same ADC2 sequence as FUN_80013c98 but with channel parameter 0.

name: GPS_USART3_Init
comment: Initialises the GPS UART on PC10/PC11 (USART3) for 9600 baud NMEA reception. Remaps GPIOC pins programs USART3 registers at 0x40004800 with divisor 0x2580 (9600 baud) enables TX/RX and powers the port.

name: GPS_SerialReader
comment: Reads NMEA bytes from USART3 buffers them and feeds the coordinate parser. Called after GPS_USART3_Init; uses DMA-like burst helper on PC10/PC11 data.

name: LCD_BlitRectangle
comment: Streams a rectangle of pixel data (RGB565) from the frame buffer at 0x20000BD0 to the LCD. param_1: top; param_2: bottom; param_3: left; param_4: right; enforces 320x240 bounds before pushing via LCD_WriteData.

name: PTT_Relay_Select
comment: Controls the TX/RX relay matrix: PE13/PE12/PE14/PE7 select PTT path while PB0/PB1 drive accessory enables. Parameter 1 chooses routing profile; toggles GPIOE via FUN_80012c3a/FUN_80012c3e and clears PB0/PB1 when idle.

name: Band_Relay_Shift_In
comment: Bit-banged serial readback of the RF relay latch using PE15/PE10/PE11. Clears PE15 (0x8000) before clocking, pulses PE10 (0x400) and samples PE11 (0x800) via FUN_80012c26.

name: LCD_SetWindow
comment: Issues column (0x2A) and row (0x2B) address commands to define the drawing window. param_1/param_2: column start/end; param_3/param_4: row start/end; calls LCD_WriteCommand/Data for each.

name: UART4_Init
comment: Brings up UART4 on PC10/PC11 at 115200 baud for accessory programming. Uses FUN_8001272c with the same GPIO masks writes 0x1C200 to UART4 (0x40004C00) and enables the channel (likely routed through the side connector).

name: LCD_WriteCommand
comment: Drives the 8080 bus control lines to emit a single command byte to the TFT panel. param_1: (uint8_t) command value; manipulates GPIOD WR#/CS# via FUN_80012c3a/3e before sending.

name: LCD_WriteData
comment: Writes one data byte to the TFT panel on the 8080 bus. param_1: (uint8_t) data value; uses same GPIOD handshake as LCD_WriteCommand but sets D/C high.
